---
title: "Contact"
description: "How to report corrections and questions about the saRNA Database."
---

## Corrections and questions

The project will use a project email address as the correction and contact channel. Users may report:

- suspected errors;
- missing publications;
- sequence discrepancies;
- metadata corrections; and
- reuse and licensing questions.

When the address is configured, contact the project through the [project email address](mailto:{{< var project-email >}}). The placeholder site does not include a submission form.

## Before the first release

The project email address will be published before the first database release. Until then, please use the repository issue and discussion mechanisms after the public repository link is confirmed.
